title: Grateful Dead Live at Saratoga Performing Arts Center on 1984-06-24
lineage: Maxell MX90 > Nakamichi LX-5 > Oade ACM Marantz PMD671 > Compact Flash > IBM ThinkPad T41 > Wavelab 5.01b (resample, dither - MegaBitMax (Medium Noise Shaping, Normal Dither Amount) > CD Wave > Flac Frontend, Level 6
source: Beyer M88 > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX90 (No Dolby)

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording captures a high‑energy Saratoga show with a standout revived 'Dancin' in the Street' opener.
ai_review.review: The audience tape is consistently clear and free of major crowd intrusion, offering an enjoyable listening experience despite not being A+ quality. The concert bursts with energy from the opening, especially the revived 60s arrangement of 'Dancin' in the Street' that gets the crowd wild and sets a great tone for the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Single positive 4‑star review highlights strong performance and decent recording; limited data yields modest confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistent audience tape with limited crowd intrusion; not A+ but clear enough for a pleasant listen.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy start with an enthusiastic revived arrangement of 'Dancin' in the Street', keeping momentum and audience excitement throughout.
